preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of problems n in each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each tag a_i must be a positive integer not exceeding n.
The total number of problems across all test cases must not exceed 100,000.

Output the minimum cost of a valid permutation if one exists.
